verdict.rationale: Square documents an official first-party Model Context Protocol server. That gives AI agents a sanctioned way to operate Square on the user's behalf through natural-language requests in an MCP client. The evidence is only a doc title and a probe confirming the page exists, and nothing shows a built-in natural-language assistant inside Square itself. Missing for 10: an in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of which operations the MCP server exposes, and hands-on or independent confirmation of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://developer.squareup.com/docs/mcp
